The posts are under a 4-year ICMR-funded extramural project on home-based palliative care for cancer patients in Delhi-NCR. The posts are Project Research Scientist – II (Medical), Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical), Project Technical Support – III (Nutrition, Physiotherapy and Psychology), Project Technical Support – I (Social work and Data Entry Operator) and Project Nurse – III. content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Delhi
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi is a medical institute in Delhi. These posts are in the Department of Onco-Anaesthesia and Palliative Medicine at Dr BR Ambedkar Institute Rotary Cancer Hospital (Dr BRAIRCH), AIIMS Delhi. They serve an ICMR-funded extramural project on home-based palliative care for cancer patients in Delhi-NCR. The Principal Investigator is Dr Seema Mishra, Professor & Head, Onco-Anaesthesia and Palliative Medicine.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 15 posts across eight positions. All of them are contractual posts under the ICMR project. content_sections.text: The notice prints the age limit for each post as shown above and does not give a date on which age is counted. Reservation policies, including age relaxation, will be applied according to the prevailing Government of India guidelines. For Project Research Scientist – II (Medical), Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical), Project Technical Support – III (Nutrition), Project Technical Support – III (Physiotherapy), Project Technical Support – III (Psychology) and Project Nurse – III: Training in emerging technologies and methodologies for knowledge management and communication would be an asset. Experience working in the area of information and knowledge management and/or communication projects in oncology. For Project Technical Support – I (Social work) and Project Technical Support – I (Data Entry Operator): Knowledge of IT applications, MS excel and words. Experience in performing data entry, data cleaning, and generating queries. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 posts under the ICMR project: Project Research Scientist – II (Medical) 2, Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical) 1, Project Technical Support – III (Nutrition, Physiotherapy, Psychology) 2 each, Project Technical Support – I (Social work, Data Entry Operator) 1 each, and Project Nurse – III 4.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi ICMR project posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 27 October 2026, 10:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Research Scientist – II (Medical) at AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MBBS/BDS with three years' experience, OR MBBS/BDS with MPH/PhD, OR MBBS/BDS plus a Post Graduate degree, including an integrated PG degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Nurse – III?
faq.answer: Project Nurse – III requires a Graduate Degree in Nursing. The age limit for the post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years for Project Research Scientist – II (Medical) and 28 years for both Project Technical Support – I posts. For Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical), all three Project Technical Support – III posts and Project Nurse – III, it is 35 years. Age relaxation follows the prevailing Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the AIIMS Delhi project posts?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is ₹80,000 for Project Research Scientist – II, ₹56,000 for Project Research Scientist – I, ₹28,000 for Project Technical Support – III and Project Nurse – III, and ₹18,000 for Project Technical Support – I.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the salary?
faq.answer: Yes. For every post, 30% HRA is paid in addition to the monthly salary.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill out the online form at https://forms.gle/5ACNb5nV8KDFaQAF6, or scan the QR code in the notice, by 27 October 2026, 10:00 PM. Send any queries to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Delhi ICMR project posts?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for a walk-in interview. The time and venue will be sent to them by email, and no TA/DA will be paid for attending.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job at AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: No. These are contractual posts under an ICMR-funded project with a project duration of 4 years.
